_comment: Public ATS job feeds imported by POST /api/ats/import (also run from 'Fetch Jobs Now', or `python -m app.services.ats_import`). 'ats' is 'greenhouse' or 'lever'. 'slug' is the Greenhouse board token or the Lever company slug — the part in the public board URL (https://boards.greenhouse.io/<token>, https://jobs.lever.co/<slug>). Every entry below was verified live against the vendor API on 2026-08-03: the board answers HTTP 200 and returns postings that pass the Saudi Arabia / UAE / GCC / Remote filter. There are NO sample or demo companies here. Postings outside the region are fetched but not saved.

companies.name: Careem
companies._note: Dubai-based super-app. 24 postings live, 11 in the UAE.

companies.name: Tamara
companies._note: Saudi fintech. 41 postings live, 30 in Riyadh / Saudi Arabia / Dubai.

companies.name: Elastic
companies._note: Remote-first; posts Dubai and Saudi Arabia roles.

companies.name: Binance
companies._note: Large Dubai / Abu Dhabi presence, plus 'Global' remote postings.

companies.name: Palantir
companies._note: Posts Abu Dhabi and Dubai roles.

companies.name: Cloudflare
companies._note: Board is live, but its GCC-passing postings are bare 'Remote' / 'Distributed' with no Gulf presence — enable if you want broad remote roles.

companies.name: Canonical
companies._note: Board is live and fully remote ('Home based - EMEA' / 'Worldwide'), ~176 pass the filter — enable if you want that volume.
